title: Crypto time-series momentum (basket 4) on the Binance USD-M futures demo, long and short, against cash and a BTC long-only control
question: Does a fixed 4h-to-daily time-series momentum rule on BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP, sized to a 60% EWMA volatility target inside fixed caps, earn a positive net return after costs against cash at equal capital in an 8-week prospective seal on the Binance USD-M demo host?

labels.name: episode_net_return
labels.definition: per episode: signed (exit fill price - entry fill price) x quantity, minus fees (the ledger's realized fee_usdt; before a fill has a recorded fee, the 0.0005 taker fee per side of the cost table), plus the demo account's real funding receipts and payments attributable to the leg, divided by the episode's leg notional. A funding record that cannot be read is unknown, never zero, and withholds that episode's scoring. An episode runs from entry to exit at signal reversal, hard stop (10% of the entry price), or a maximum holding time of 30 days.

splits.scheme: No fitting on the sealed period. Exploration backtest on the most recent 3 years of the Binance public kline archive (CT-2, one comparison of L in {20, 60, 120} days, not counted as a test look). Exploration periods do not overlap the prospective test; folds stay empty because the test is prospective.

test.exposure_audit: At scoring time, compare each signal with the real position exposure read from the ledger and the broker account (the demo account is shared with other strategies; conflict rejects are reported separately).
test.seal_rule: Freeze time = the merge of this seal PR into main: start = the UTC date of that merge, end = start + 55 calendar days, 56 consecutive UTC days inclusive (8 weeks, operator decision Q5). This version records the freeze date as 2026-11-15 (the date it was committed) and therefore 2026-11-15 through 2027-01-09; only decisions timestamped at or after the freeze count, so a later merge date moves both ends together and no decision before the merge is ever counted. The length is fixed at the freeze; the window is never extended, shortened or reopened. Any change to rule, universe, caps, cost table or code SHA is a new manifest version and a new seal (design section 3.3).

candidate_policies.description: Daily TSMOM on BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT (DOGEUSDT excluded). Long when the sign is positive, short when negative, one entry and one exit per episode, no adds. Lookback L = 60 days, chosen once by the CT-2 exploration under its pre-declared rule and fixed at seal. Volatility target sigma_star = 60% with 20-day EWMA; notional = cap x min(1, sigma_star / sigma_hat), never above cap. Leg notional cap USD 60, at most 4 concurrent positions, gross cap USD 240, 1x isolated.
Primary control: the same capital held in cash; unspent capital earns zero. The primary comparison is candidate against this control.
Secondary control: the same rule, same caps and same capital, restricted to BTCUSDT long positions. Isolates the contribution of the short side.

fill_models: exploration default: conservative through, a touch of a level is not a fill
prospective: broker fill evidence only (ledger after bounded poll, then account position read); a status NEW order is not treated as filled until the evidence is in

tuning_budget.search: One comparison of the lookback L in {20, 60, 120} days on the exploration archive (CT-2); the sealed value is L = 60 days, CT-2's pre-declared choice. sigma_star = 60% and the 20-day EWMA window are operator-fixed (Q2) and are not tuned. The hard stop (10% of the entry price) and delta_min (0.00) are operator-fixed at seal and are not tuned. The control policies are not tuned.
tuning_budget.notes: Each configuration compared counts against max_configurations; no other search is allowed. The rule, the volatility scale, the sizing and both controls are deterministic — they use no random number generator, so seeds is [0], the schema-required placeholder rather than a sampled seed.

metrics.primary: net return after costs of candidate-tsmom against control-cash at equal capital, over the sealed window
family: ROB-3796 single primary: candidate-tsmom against control-cash; no multiple-comparison correction

stopping_rules: (i) At the end of the sealed window, a primary net return after costs at or below 0 ends the experiment.

(ii) Hard stop: a 1m extreme (high or low) of an open leg beyond 10% of its entry price exits that leg at market; the fraction is SEAL_HARD_STOP_FRACTION = 0.10 and is never tuned. A 1m fetch failure on a tick decides that tick on the 4h close only and is recorded (Q3).
(iii) Kill switch: after 2 consecutive hard-stop exits in a UTC day, no new entry that UTC day; management of open legs continues.
(iv) Exposure: an entry that would exceed 4 concurrent positions or USD 240 gross is refused; the caps are not raised by any path.
(v) Conflict: 3 or more conflict rejects in a UTC week hold new entries until the operator decides on account separation (decision revision 1).
(vi) The monthly loss limit of the experiment budget (decision section 1, item 2c) applies to any promotion judgment.
Isolated margin and 1x leverage are read back and required; the runner issues no margin or leverage mutation (Q4).
Funding: the demo account's real funding receipts and payments are included in the net return; a funding record that cannot be read is unknown, never zero, and withholds scoring.
Upbit live is out of scope (Q6); this manifest registers no Upbit order path.
The Binance live host is not allowed; only the demo host is used (design section 1.2).
Missing path-dependent bars or a failed exploration fetch make the result unverified, never zero.
No statistical promotion from exploration evidence; the sealed window alone decides.
